- **rule** `editor/land-each-finished-verified-editor-slice`: Land each finished, verified editor slice promptly through the merge queue and normal live deployment, without waiting for owner review or a complete workflow milestone. Preserve the live review route and phone access, report the deployed revision honestly, and leave a durable next task so fresh sessions can continue from main. Treat owner workflow review as asynchronous feedback rather than a routine landing gate.
- **rule** `root/distinguish-engineering-verification-readiness-workflow-review`: Distinguish engineering verification, readiness for workflow review and actual owner acceptance. Before requesting owner testing, prove a usable end-to-end task in the real UI, including ordinary controls needed to finish it; report missing essentials as unfinished workflow, and let agents catch routine defects. Keep technical slices small, but group their review around useful outcomes rather than asking the owner to test every partial control.
